description: This file defines a console module for a Kivy-based application, providing an inspector/debugging interface with addons, widget hierarchy visualization, property editing, and keyboard/mouse navigation.

classes.name: TreeViewProperty
classes.description: A layout and node class for displaying widget properties in the console property editor.

classes.name: ConsoleButton
classes.description: A specialized Button widget for the console interface.

classes.name: ConsoleToggleButton
classes.description: A toggle button widget for the console interface.

classes.name: ConsoleLabel
classes.description: A label widget used within the console.

classes.name: ConsoleAddon
classes.description: Base class for console addons, providing hooks for init, activate, and deactivate.

classes.name: ConsoleAddonMode
classes.description: Addon to toggle console docking mode.

classes.name: ConsoleAddonSelect
classes.description: Addon to activate widget selection mode.

classes.name: ConsoleAddonFps
classes.description: Addon to display current FPS in the console toolbar.

classes.name: ConsoleAddonBreadcrumbView
classes.description: View component displaying widget hierarchy breadcrumbs.

classes.name: ConsoleAddonBreadcrumb
classes.description: Addon to display and update widget hierarchy breadcrumbs.

classes.name: ConsoleAddonWidgetPanel
classes.description: Addon to display and edit properties of the selected widget.

classes.name: Console
classes.description: Main console interface widget providing inspection, widget hierarchy, property editing, and addon management.

methods.name: ignore_exception
methods.description: Decorator to suppress exceptions in functions.

methods.name: on_widget
methods.description: Updates breadcrumb view when the widget property changes.

methods.name: highlight_widget
methods.description: Highlights a widget in the console overlay.

methods.name: update_widget_graphics
methods.description: Updates the overlay rectangle to match the selected widget.

methods.name: pick
methods.description: Recursively finds the widget at given x/y coordinates.

methods.name: _activate_console
methods.description: Activates the console widget and its addons.

methods.name: _deactivate_console
methods.description: Deactivates the console widget and its addons.

methods.name: keyboard_shortcut
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts for toggling console and navigating widgets.

methods.name: create_console
methods.description: Creates and binds a console to the window and context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Schedules creation of the console attached to the window and context.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Removes and unbinds the console from the window and context.
